provenance.reference: af06299 initial public release; migrated from tests/manifest.json and tests/test_detector.py at a8c6ee2
provenance.origin: Frame at 23.267 s of a user screen recording in which a later garage frame was once counted as a second WIN (the v19 precision regression).

truth.basis: The implementer viewed the full ROI: it shows a rank screen with a rank emblem, a points value and an AC model; rank truth is deliberately not recorded. The checked frame class is the legacy expectation from tests/manifest.json.

privacy.notes: The implementer inspected the full ROI at 2x. No player or opponent name, Steam identifier, notification, third-party overlay, desktop, local path, token or secret is visible, and the PPM header carries no comment field. An in-game rank emblem and the points value 79200 are visible; they are game statistics with no name or account identifier.

redistribution.notes: Committed by the repository owner in the initial public release (af06299, 2026-08-30) and public since. It contains ARMORED CORE VI game imagery; this records where the asset came from, not a licence determination.
